name: eu-nordic-open-data-mcp
description: 10 official EU & Nordic open-data MCP servers & Apify Actors (TED Tenders, EU Sanctions, VIES VAT, ECB FX/Macro, ENISA EUVD, PRH/YTJ Finnish Companies, Fingrid Grid Signals, FMI Weather & Marine Alerts, Digitraffic Port Calls) with built-in GDPR personal-data redaction and licence attribution.

servers.name: ted-tender-feed
servers.description: Search & monitor official EU TED public procurement notices (api.ted.europa.eu/v3) by CPV code, country, and date with stateful alert mode.

servers.name: prh-company-events
servers.description: Track daily Finnish Trade Register (PRH / YTJ) company events and Business ID (Y-tunnus) watchlists with GDPR company-level filtering.

servers.name: eu-sanctions-screen
servers.description: Screen names, companies & IDs against the official European Commission Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (DG FISMA FSF).

servers.name: fingrid-grid-signals
servers.description: Real-time & forecast Finnish electricity grid signals, reserves, imbalance prices, CO2 intensity & low-residual-load hours from Fingrid Open Data.

servers.name: fmi-fingrid-nowcast
servers.description: Joined hourly FMI meteorological hub forecasts + Fingrid wind/solar/consumption forecasts and EV smart-charging windows.

servers.name: fmi-weather-warnings-alerts
servers.description: Real-time Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI) CAP 1.2 severe weather & marine alerts, synoptic observations, and Baltic mareograph sea levels.

servers.name: eu-vies-vat-validator
servers.description: Batch-validate EU & XI VAT numbers against the official European Commission VIES REST API with reverse-charge flags and automatic GDPR sole-trader redaction.

servers.name: ecb-fx-rates-macro
servers.description: Official European Central Bank (ECB SDMX 2.1) EUR reference exchange rates, policy interest rates, HICP inflation, and B2B invoice currency converter.

servers.name: digitraffic-port-calls-marine
servers.description: Real-time & scheduled Baltic Sea and Finnish vessel port calls, berth ETA/ETD schedules, turnaround times, and port congestion summaries.

servers.name: enisa-euvd-vulnerabilities
servers.description: Query the official EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) European Vulnerability Database (EUVD) for actively exploited vulnerabilities (KEV), critical CVEs, and EPSS.
